description: This Java source file defines the ContentMapFacade class, which implements a Map interface for content management within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to access content data, subcontent, metadata, and rendering functionalities, and manages content-related objects and filters.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Represents content object, provides access to content fields and related content.

classes.name: SubContent
classes.description: Handles subcontent retrieval and filtering based on map key and status.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Provides access to content metadata based on predicate ID.

classes.name: DataResource
classes.description: Accesses data resource related objects and rendering.

methods.name: setRenderFlag
methods.description: Sets whether content can be rendered.

methods.name: setIsDecorated
methods.description: Sets whether the content is decorated.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for subcontent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves content data, link, subcontent, metadata, or renders content based on key.

methods.name: renderThis
methods.description: Renders the content as text, considering decoration and recursion prevention.
